name: Procedural Film Maker
tagline: Builds a world from pure code and films it: a cinematic short with its own synthesized soundtrack, no assets.
delivers: The film: an ultra-wide MP4 with a synthesized nature bed and score
The full source in Python and GLSL: terrain, water, foliage, sky, camera, grade and audio, all generated, with no textures, meshes, HDRIs or samples
A guide to re-rendering at higher quality and changing shots, light and music
tools: GLSL ray marching via moderngl (headless EGL)

brief.label: What place should it build?
brief.example: An alpine lake valley: glacial trough, conifer forest, a twin waterfall, granite boulders on the shore

brief.label: Reference photos or a mood (optional)
brief.example: Clear morning light, turquoise water, not too grey

brief.label: The film: length, aspect, pacing, music
brief.example: 30 seconds, 21:9, drone-like moves, a new place every 6 seconds, calm nature sounds and an epic score

limits: Landscapes and environments rendered offline from code. No characters, dialogue or real-time games. Quality and length scale with render time.
